blocks.text: Hypothesis research mein ek assumption ya statement (bayan) hai jo testing shuru hone se pehle banaya jata hai. Is statement ko data se test kiya ja sakta hai. Hypothesis kisi nateeje ki prediction (peshgoi) karta hai, is liye use wazeh aur measurable (napne ke qabil) hona chahiye. Data se use check kiya jata hai. Durust hypothesis analysis ko sahi raste par rakhta hai aur study ko focused rakhta hai.

items: hθ(x): hypothesis function, jis ke parameters θ hain aur jo input x par lagta hai.
x: input features ya data points (maslan dataset ki khasiyat, attributes).
y: predicted output ya target value (diye gaye input par model ka andaza).
θ: model ke parameters ya weights (maslan linear regression model ke coefficients).

blocks.title: Machine learning mein doosra matlab
blocks.text: Yahan 'hypothesis' ka machine learning wala matlab hai: hθ(x) model ka andaza lagane wala qaida (prediction function) hai, jaise Chapter 6 ka Exam Score = 0.6552 × Hours + 0.1466. Is chapter mein jo hypothesis test hota hai woh statistics wala hypothesis hai (H₀ aur H₁), yani data ke baare mein ek daawa. Dono ka naam ek hai magar kaam alag.
